composition.deduplication: OSM object type, ID and version

cost: Original road length in integer centimetres; shortest distance, not estimated travel time.
limitations: Turn restrictions, barriers and conditional access are retained as source evidence but are not applied.
Ferries and non-motor-road classes are excluded.
Physical-phone memory and stability remain unverified.
coverage: Eleven complete country extracts: South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho, Eswatini, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Mozambique, Malawi, Angola and Tanzania. No clipping, tracks or ferry edges.
